subject: Payment freeze: VAT reconciliation & leadership approval needed
messages:
From: Lina Gomez <lina.gomez@cobaltlabs.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-02-22T09:12:00Z
Subject: Re: Invoice INV-2026-193 - withholding payment until VAT clarification

Hi Irene,

Quick heads up — our finance team has put INV-2026-193 on hold. They say the VAT line doesn't match the tax ID we have on record for Redwood's EU entity, so they're withholding the payment until we get a corrected invoice and supporting VAT evidence.

This is a hard stop on our side until Treasury confirms. Can you send the VAT breakdown and the vendor tax registration? If we can't resolve this this week our AP team will push the payment to next month.

Apologies for the delay; aiming to sort quickly.

Thanks,
Lina
Finance Manager, Cobalt Labs
accounts@cobaltlabs.com

Attachment: Cobalt_VAT_question.txt (note from AP)
From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
To: Lina Gomez <lina.gomez@cobaltlabs.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-02-22T11:03:00Z
Subject: Re: Invoice INV-2026-193 - withholding payment until VAT clarification

Hi Lina — thanks for the flag.

We're looking into the VAT numbering mismatch now. I can:
- Send an itemized VAT breakdown for INV-2026-193 (attached)
- Provide Redwood's EU tax registration and our VAT certificate
- Offer a staged payment plan for the outstanding balance if your AP needs time for treasury sign-off

Proposed payment path: 50% on receipt of corrected docs, remaining 50% within 30 days. We can accelerate a corrected invoice today if needed.

Looping in Marcus (collections) and Kimberly (Head of Credit) to confirm approvals for the staged plan.

Best,
Irene
Senior Account Manager — Americas & EMEA
Redwood Inference

Attachments: INV-2026-193_vat_breakdown.pdf, Redwood_EU_VAT_certificate.pdf
From: accounts@cobaltlabs.com <accounts@cobaltlabs.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-02-22T14:21:00Z
Subject: Re: Invoice INV-2026-193 - withholding payment until VAT clarification

Hi Irene,

Thanks for the quick reply. Treasury says they need either:
1) a corrected invoice showing the VAT with Redwood's EU VAT registration number, or
2) confirmation that the supply is zero-rated under the local VAT rules with supporting paperwork.

If you can provide the corrected invoice and Redwood's EU registered vendor number we can release 50% today and finish the remainder on 2027-03-24. If not, our AP will keep the hold.

Lina (copied) will confirm once documents arrive.

Regards,
Cobalt AP Team

Attachment: AP_hold_notice.pdf
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-02-22T16:05:00Z
Subject: Re: Invoice INV-2026-193 - withholding payment until VAT clarification

Irene — thanks for looping us in. Two points from Credit: 

1) Approve the 50/50 staged payment as an exception for Cobalt Labs (they're strategic). Please get it in writing from the customer and request a remittance schedule.
2) We need Legal on standby if the VAT mismatch persists. Marcus, please prepare the payment aging summary and escalation slide for my review.

Irene: if you push the corrected invoice and VAT certificate now and get a written commitment to 50% today, Credit will sign off on the partial acceptance. I'm attaching a one-off approval note you can forward if helpful.

- Kimberly
Head of Credit, Redwood Inference

Attachment: credit-approval-note.pdf

Subject: Re: Invoice INV-2026-193 - withholding payment until VAT clarification

Lina — attaching the corrected invoice and our EU VAT registration.

We can accept the staged payment you proposed: 50% on receipt of the corrected invoice (today) and 50% by 2027-03-24. Kimberly has provided one-time Credit approval and Marcus will track the aging. Neha (VP, Revenue Operations) is copied as this touches AR policy for multi-entity remits.

Please confirm the 50% release and share the remittance reference once payment is sent so we can mark the invoice as partially settled.

Thanks,
Irene

Irene / team — confirmed. Treasury released 50% today (reference: COB-REF-7721). Attached remittance confirmation and our internal note. We will settle the remaining 50% by 2027-03-24 as agreed.

Appreciate the quick turnaround on the corrected invoice and the paperwork. If anything else is needed to close the ticket, Lina will follow up.

Best,
Lina
